answer: Survey rights on the dune for epoch 135 vest only after a key locks 20 POA for four epochs and files one prism reading of a buried relic. Readings from separate rigs scatter differently, so two keys filing the same prism spectrum reveal one operator; any peer who posts that match slashes both locks and keeps half. Clean locks return after four epochs, so honest surveyors lose only time. A farm of 300 keys sharing one rig files 300 matching spectra and loses every lock: 300 x 20 = 6,000 POA the attacker forfeits.
